A CEO cited Batman to
justify 80,000 cameras.

The film ends with the
system shut down.

slides.title:
AI infrastructure share of
US economic growth
slides.source: Source: cited in The Drop, Issue 51

slides.copy:
A $20 subscription is
doing a $235,000 job.

Nobody asked how
the film ends.

Ten summers of doorbell
cameras made 80,000
more feel normal.

The warnings were read
as instruction manuals.
